procedure: For multipart packages, use audit-tools/reassemble_settings_f9_archive.py PACKAGE/archive-parts.json --output OUTPUT.tar.gz. It verifies every ordered part and the exact original archive bytes/hash; this is transport splitting only.
Check each package SHA256SUMS and manifest, then unpack into a separate run root.
Obtain exact Git objects for baseline 2254d6956de778cc54aa42fe610bcdf94f5301a5, accepted source, checkout and master; runtime source and tests are read from these objects.

Reobtain original artifact ZIPs by the retained API IDs/digests where required. Package exclusions are explicit: these bundles do not contain every original ZIP or every extracted binary/diagnostic member.
Run cloud_evidence.py audit for 23 jobs and 13 XML, allowing only AGENTS.md, docs/* and story/* source-to-merge differences; copy its exact source_boundary to audit/source-provenance.json.
Run audit_settings_load_inventory.py discovery and public without suite narrowing; run audit_settings_load_journey_v3.py and audit_physical_selector_journey.py against the same source/checkout/run.

Run join_settings_f9_acceptance_v2.py only after all component audits pass. This successor adapts the retained F5 job_id field without changing the audited execution. The join rehashes actual artifact members, so excluded members must be restored from verified original ZIPs for a fresh join.
limits: Retained helper code is not a promise of complete offline replay from compressed records alone.
All engine and PowerShell execution occurred in GitHub Actions; Python audits inspect source and recorded evidence only.
